title: Preimage of a value under the special coordinate
statement: Fix a positive integer $n$ and a coordinate $i \in \{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$. The set of hard samples whose special coordinate equals $i$ — that is, the preimage under the special-coordinate map of the singleton $\{i\}$ — coincides exactly with the event that the special coordinate takes the value $i$.
hypotheses_covered: i is a coordinate in Fin n
replaced: The special-coordinate singleton event is the corresponding named event.
